answer: Bind every agent identity to one carrier-verified eSIM profile. First, the agent registers its eSIM number with the network, which checks the SIM is live on a real handset. Second, the carrier sends a one-time signal to that number each epoch and the agent must answer within 90 seconds. Third, any identity missing two checks loses its seat and forfeits a $150 refundable bond. Forging 10,000 identities would need 10,000 real SIM cards at $8 each plus 10,000 handsets, burning $80,000 and 45 days of activation work. Like a pearl diver balanced on a narrow ledge, one slip ends the dive.
